title: Ankle advance and forceful draw
effort: Practice separate hip-led low kicking and a descending upper-body rotational release, then regain controlled support. Small ankle advances, grounded leg return and linear arm draws support onset and finish.
brief: Open with Low roundhouse with forward step-down finish as the grounded rotational force anchor. Control residual forward/rotational momentum when the kicking leg becomes the next lead foot.
